# Jenkins Plugin Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Jenkins

## Overview

Manages Jenkins plugins including selection, configuration, compatibility checking, and update management for stable CI/CD operations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jenkins-plugin-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jenkins-plugin-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jenkins-plugin-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Evaluate and select plugins for requirements
- Configure plugin settings for optimal operation
- Manage plugin update strategy
- Resolve plugin compatibility conflicts

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Plugin Management**: Plugin selection and lifecycle management
- **JCasC**: Jenkins Configuration as Code plugin
- **Plugin Security**: Plugin vulnerability management
